::: callout-note
Zenodo's terms can sometimes be a bit confusing. The two main terms are:

- Deposit: A Zenodo deposit is a set of files and metadata uploaded to Zenodo
  that will eventually form a published record. For a given output (e.g. an
  academic paper), there is only one deposit. However, the information contained
  in a deposit can still be updated or changed.
- Record: A Zenodo record is a deposit that has been permanently published and
  assigned a DOI. There can be multiple records for any given deposit. A record
  is something you can't change and is sometimes called a "version".
:::
